description.value: Howler's Liquor Store is a liquor retailer serving the remote North Coast and Haida Gwaii region of British Columbia, one of the most isolated touring destinations in Canada. For cyclists making the journey to Haida Gwaii, a reliable bottle shop is a meaningful stop after long stretches with few services. Its location in this sparsely populated archipelago makes it a notable landmark for self-supported tourers resupplying on the islands.
